description: Returns what the app's Development holds as the gemmein/ file set (path → contents): its name, every collection's declaration, payments.json, relays, AI tools and aliases, email templates. Useful in a project that has no gemmein/ folder yet, or before editing, to start from what is there. File paths are the gemmein/ project files: gemmein/gemmein.config.json, gemmein/collections/<name>.json, gemmein/payments.json, gemmein/relays/<name>.json, gemmein/ai/tools/<name>.json, gemmein/ai/aliases.json, gemmein/emails/<name>.html, gemmein/emails/sign-in.json — the same formats the guide teaches. Secrets are never in it.
name: pull
title: Pull the gemmein/ files
